title: Neighborly
summary: NEIGHBORLY, adjective 1. Becoming a neighbor; kind; civil. Judge if this be neighborly dealing. 2. Cultivating familiar intercourse; interchanging frequent visits; social. Friend, you are not neighbor

inlines.v: NEIGHBORLY, adjective 1. Becoming a neighbor; kind; civil. Judge if this be neighborly dealing. 2. Cultivating familiar intercourse; interchanging frequent visits; social. Friend, you are not neighborly NEIGHBORLY, adverb With social civility; as, to live neighborly
